name: mathacademy_timeback
what: mathacademy_timeback is the meaning layer for Math Academy data as it lives inside Timeback: every Math Academy task a student completes arrives as a Caliper event and is stored in Timeback's OneRoster (assessment results, line items, enrollments, classes, courses, users) and EduBridge analytics (event facts, daily rollups). Readers use a Timeback credential only; this skill never calls Math Academy. It answers, numbered to match ENABLEMENT § Capabilities: (1) a student's Math Academy task history with type, topic, XP, accuracy and time; (2) daily and weekly totals per student; (3) the student's current Math Academy course, completion percent and its age, and an estimated XP remaining with its basis and bias named; (4) who has gone quiet in a course; (5) who has finished a course and whether they were moved on; (6) where a student is struggling, by topic, and whether they recovered; (7) whether a student's Timeback course looks wrong, as a heuristic suspect-course flag with its uncheckable and quiet buckets named; (8) estate-wide Math Academy activity for a day or week attributed to the course each event was filed under; (9) a student's whole Math Academy timeline across seats, including events filed under deleted seats; (10) Math Academy's own figures for a student as of a dated snapshot held by this skill (the course Math Academy really runs them in, exact XP remaining, progress, grade and letter grade, estimated SAT score, account state) with a live check of whether the Timeback seat agrees, served behind the reader's Timeback token.
when: Reach for mathacademy_timeback when the question is about Math Academy students and can be answered from what Timeback received: activity, progress percent, quiet students, finished students, failed tasks, a student's history across seats, and whether the Timeback course record is coherent. For Math Academy's own figures (true course, exact XP remaining, grade, SAT estimate) read this skill's snapshot store first (how.native.store; ENABLEMENT example 10); it is dated, and every response carries snapshotAt. Route away to the Math Academy API only for what is fresher than the snapshot or never in it: the per-topic knowledge map, engaged versus productive time, the course catalogue; ENABLEMENT.md § One-off exact figures gives the per-student calls and the key they need, as a fallback outside this skill's wire, never a polling path. Route to timeback_production (https://timeback-loops-k8.vercel.app/dss/timeback_production/skill) or timeback_analytics (https://platform.timeback.com/mcps/analytics/skill) for the whole learning record across apps, MAP and mastery, screen-capture minutes and waste. The headline trap: the Timeback course an event is filed under is the course of the enrollment the platform matched at ingestion, often a since-deleted one and never the course Math Academy is actually running the student in; if the enrollment is wrong every event is filed under the wrong course and no field says so (DICTIONARY traps 10 and 21, ENABLEMENT examples 7, 8 and 9).

why.relevance: Math Academy is the core mathematics app for Alpha students in grades 4 to 12, and its events are the largest single external activity stream Timeback holds for math. The raw rows do not explain themselves: the task type hides in a URL, waste is always zero, reviews revisit earlier courses, titles are not canonical, and completion percent lives in two places. This skill supplies the genesis of every field, the named traps, and worked recipes, so a cold agent can answer without being silently wrong and without spamming the Math Academy API.
why.note: sha256 pins the exact bytes served at GET https://data-source-skills.vercel.app/contract on the day this front was built; version echoes that fetch's X-Doc-Version header. Re-pinned on every deploy.

native.auth: Bearer <token>; the reader brings its own Timeback credential. Mint the token with an OAuth 2.0 client-credentials POST (grant_type=client_credentials, client id + secret) to https://prod-beyond-timeback-api-2-idp.auth.us-east-1.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/token; tokens expire after expires_in seconds (one hour as served). This front holds no key and proxies no data.
native.keyKind: a Timeback API client (OAuth 2.0 client id + secret on the Cognito pool above) with READ-ONLY scopes covering OneRoster rostering + gradebook reads and EduBridge analytics reads (the scopes named powerpath.readonly and analytics/v1p0/readOnly were sufficient for every call in ENABLEMENT.md). No write scope is needed and none should be granted.
native.keyContact: one client per person or agent, never shared: request it from the Timeback platform team (owner of api.alpha-1edtech.ai; tracker trilogy-group/timeback-platform). This skill issues no keys.
native.denied: a 401 on the token endpoint is a bad or expired client; a 403 or an empty result on a route that works for others is a scope or org limit of YOUR key, never an absence of data.

store.what: a dated snapshot of Math Academy's student records (bulk students list + per-student lookups, Math Academy public API beta10), matched to Timeback students and held by this skill; no refresh is scheduled and every response carries snapshotAt
store.status: GET https://vgdv4g6yf4xf6jdlbfxq5mzoou0xsegi.lambda-url.us-east-1.on.aws/store  (snapshotAt, apiVersion, counts, calls; no student values; no credential)
store.gate: Authorization: Bearer <the reader's own Timeback token>. The route replays it against Timeback (GET users/{sourcedId}, GET enrollments) and serves the row only if Timeback answers 200 for that student under that token; a reader sees exactly the students its Timeback key can read. No Math Academy call is made at read time, and this skill holds no Math Academy key on its wire.
store.fields: mathAcademy {id, username, firstName, lastName, created, deactivated, currentCourse {id, name, startDate, progress, xpRemaining, completed, grade, letterGrade, estimatedScore}, schedule, league}, matchedBy (username | email | lookup | name), timeback.currentMathAcademySeats (live), courseAgreement (agree | disagree | disagree, math academy course completed | no current timeback seat | math academy has no current course | no math academy record | not in snapshot); DICTIONARY § The Math Academy snapshot store

courses.purpose: the domain of the course field: every OneRoster course titled Math Academy, with ids; a dated snapshot (readAt inside), regenerate with the call it names

courseXpSize.purpose: the XP-remaining rule list; reads the course's totalXp live, carries no figure

topicCourseMap.purpose: topic id -> majority filed course id, a dated heuristic snapshot for ENABLEMENT example 7; regenerate rather than trust

DICTIONARY.md.purpose: DICTIONARY.md carries what the OpenAPI cannot: how each Math Academy field inside Timeback is born, what its values mean, the containers and their range, the invariants and their standing, and the numbered traps. Open it before trusting any field.

ENABLEMENT.md.purpose: ENABLEMENT.md puts the source to work: ten capabilities, a question-to-call catalog, and ten worked examples with exact routes, output shapes and failure modes. Open it when you need to act.

documents.note: sha256 + gitVersion pin the exact bytes served at each url on this deploy; the .md routes echo them as X-Doc-SHA256 / X-Doc-Version headers.

personBearingFields: assessmentResults metadata.studentEmail (other apps' rows in a student-filtered read)
pii.readRule: a reader may read and join on these inside its own session to answer the question it was asked; several arrive unasked (DICTIONARY trap 24), so scrub cached responses
pii.publishRule: nothing that leaves the reader's session (report, dashboard, ticket, message, a file another process reads) carries a child's name, email, SIS number or login, or a row that identifies one child on its face; publish counts, classes, course ids, aggregates, or opaque user.sourcedId values to a recipient entitled to resolve them (a guide, a dashboard behind the school's login), never as a public artifact
pii.documents: every worked example in ENABLEMENT.md keys its output on user.sourcedId; DICTIONARY.md § Students are children states the rule and marks the fields
pii.servedValues: no served document or reference file of this skill contains any student value; the store routes serve one student's record only behind that reader's Timeback token, and /store serves counts only

feedback.covers: This lane covers this skill's two documents, its front, its reference files, and its snapshot store routes (a wrong match, a stale snapshot, a missing student). A defect in Timeback's APIs or data belongs to the Timeback platform (trilogy-group/timeback-platform); a defect in Math Academy's own product belongs to Math Academy. This wire does not relay third-party claims to either.
feedback.report: POST https://vgdv4g6yf4xf6jdlbfxq5mzoou0xsegi.lambda-url.us-east-1.on.aws/feedback with JSON {title, body, reporter, kind?} -> 201 {number, url}; no credential required
feedback.resolved: GET https://vgdv4g6yf4xf6jdlbfxq5mzoou0xsegi.lambda-url.us-east-1.on.aws/feedback?state=closed  (or https://vgdv4g6yf4xf6jdlbfxq5mzoou0xsegi.lambda-url.us-east-1.on.aws/feedback/{number} for one ticket with its thread)
feedback.tracker: this skill's own tracker, served at GET https://vgdv4g6yf4xf6jdlbfxq5mzoou0xsegi.lambda-url.us-east-1.on.aws/feedback/{number}; every ticket is mirrored daily into a GitHub issue on trilogy-group/mathacademy-timeback-skill (labels skill-feedback + mathacademy_timeback) and closures on GitHub are copied back
feedback.note: Files an attributed ticket on the skill's own tracker and returns its number and URL at once; the ticket gains a githubUrl once the daily mirror runs. reporter is a free-text attribution and is required. kind is optional ('ask' | 'report'). Evidence in a ticket is a class, a field, a rule or a query; never a student's name, contact or identifying row.

provider.genesis: Written by an agent against the live Timeback wire on 2026-09-16, cross-checked against the Math Academy API during the build (one student's feed, the population's completion percent, task types on three students, XP remaining on ten), then corrected from the estate's registration panel and five independent cold runs on 2026-09-17; kept true by reader feedback.
